title: Adaptable Cardiovascular Disease Risk Prediction from Heterogeneous Data using Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model predictive performance (AUROC) across male and female patient subgroups.
Evaluating model predictive performance (AUROC) stratified by patient age groups (38-50, 50-60, and 60-70 years).
Measuring model performance (AUROC) across varying levels of household income, educational attainment, and access to private healthcare.
Comparing model performance (AUROC) across patient subgroups based on health conditions and lifestyle factors, such as diabetes status, BMI categories, and smoking status.
Evaluating model predictive performance (AUROC) stratified by home area population density (urban, suburban & small town, and rural).
